title: M5 stage39: global arithmetic residue occurrence criterion
scope: Original w>=2 global occurrence criterion, bounded source and same-support progression; A is the existing divisor/factor arithmetic formula. Stage31 proof import pending.

spec.name: M5.GlobalCriterion.physical_implies_A_positive
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (S U : Finset ℕ), 0 < w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F S U → 0 < M5.ResidueCount.A w F
queries: Fin cons self tail successor sum
spec.guidance:
Use accepted period_necessity35 to get full feasible tuples, period_law for positive T, and full_to_tail. The positivity equivalence in stage31 period_A_exact gives A>0. No supplied periodpattern premise.
Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
Exact imported local API (period_A_exact available only after verified stage31 promotion):
M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchor_zero : ∀ (T k : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (r : Fin k → Fin T), ∀ i : Fin (k + 1), i.val = 0 → (M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchored hT r i).val = 0
M5.ResidueTailBridge.polynomial_cons : ∀ (T k : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (r : Fin k → Fin T), M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple (M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchored hT r) = 1 + ∑ i : Fin k, (Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ (r i).val
M5.ResidueTailBridge.gcd_cons : ∀ (T k : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (r : Fin k → Fin T), Finset.univ.gcd (fun i : Fin (k + 1) => (M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchored hT r i).val) = Finset.univ.gcd (fun i : Fin k => (r i).val)
M5.ResidueNecessity.period_necessity : ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A B : Finset ℕ), 0 < w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F A B → ∃ r s : Fin w → Fin (M5.signaturePeriod F), M5.BoundedConstruction.anchoredTuple r ∧ M5.BoundedConstruction.anchoredTuple s ∧ M5.BoundedConstruction.tupleSupportGcd r s = 1 ∧ M5.completeSignature (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple r) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple s) (M5.signaturePeriod F) = F
M5.FeasibleSource.same_support_infinite_progression : ∀ (w T : ℕ) (r s : Fin w → Fin T) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 2 ≤ w → 0 < T → M5.BoundedConstruction.anchoredTuple r → M5.BoundedConstruction.anchoredTuple s → M5.BoundedConstruction.tupleSupportGcd r s = 1 → M5.completeSignature (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple r) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple s) T = F → ∃ (A : Finset ℕ) (N E : ℕ), 0 < E ∧ N < M5.birthBound w T ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes (N + j * E) w F A (M5.Packing.packedSupport s)
M5.Period.period_law : ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 < M5.signaturePeriod F ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N ↔ M5.signaturePeriod F ∣ N
M5.ResidueCount.period_A_exact : ∀ (w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.ResidueCount.A w F = (M5.ResidueCount.validTailPairs (M5.signaturePeriod F) w F).card ∧ 0 ≤ M5.ResidueCount.A w F ∧ (0 < M5.ResidueCount.A w F ↔ ∃ a b : Fin (w-1) → Fin (M5.signaturePeriod F), M5.ResidueCount.feasible F a b)
Retained accepted helper: M5.GlobalCriterion.full_to_tail : ∀ (w T : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (r s : Fin w → Fin T), 0 < w → 0 < T → M5.BoundedConstruction.anchoredTuple r → M5.BoundedConstruction.anchoredTuple s → M5.BoundedConstruction.tupleSupportGcd r s = 1 → M5.completeSignature (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple r) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple s) T = F → ∃ a b : Fin (w-1) → Fin T, M5.ResidueCount.feasible F a b

spec.name: M5.GlobalCriterion.positive_bounded_progression
spec.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 2 ≤ w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 < M5.ResidueCount.A w F → ∃ (S U : Finset ℕ) (N E : ℕ), 0 < E ∧ N < M5.birthBound w (M5.signaturePeriod F) ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes (N + j * E) w F S U
queries: Fin cons self tail successor sum
spec.guidance:
Use period_A_exact for feasible tails and period_law for positive T. Cases w to write w=k+1; prepend zero via ResidueTailBridge.anchored, use anchor_zero/gcd_cons/polynomial_cons to get full feasible tuples, then accepted same_support_infinite_progression28. Keep actual A arithmetic definition unchanged. Conclusion gives both a bounded source at j0 and a positive-step infinite progression using the same supports.
Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.GlobalCriterion.global_occurrence_criterion
spec.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 2 ≤ w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 ≤ M5.ResidueCount.A w F ∧ (0 < M5.ResidueCount.A w F ↔ ∃ (N : ℕ) (S U : Finset ℕ), M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F S U) ∧ (M5.ResidueCount.A w F = 0 ↔ ¬ (∃ (N : ℕ) (S U : Finset ℕ), M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F S U))
queries: Fin cons self tail successor sum
spec.guidance:
Nonnegativity is period_A_exact. Positive A gives actual physical existence by positive_bounded_progression at j=0; reverse is physical_implies_A_positive. Use integer nonnegativity to get zero iff no realization. This is the global existence criterion: no input physical witness or periodpattern premise, and no new efficiency/distance/ordering goal.
Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
